name: Rainbow Children's Medicare Ltd
title: Rainbow Children's Medicare Ltd - 543524 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Rainbow added ~500 beds yet FY26 revenue grew only 12% and mature-hospital occupancy slipped; management targets ~20% growth and 56–58% blended occupancy, with ~900 beds funded internally.

utilisation.quote: Occupancy for the quarter stood at 45.3%.

capex.quote: we expect an additional investment of around INR 400 crores towards the Gurugram facilities

triggers.label: Occupancy 45.3% in Q4 vs 56–58% target
triggers.quote: if we can maintain a blended occupancy of 56% –58% across the group

triggers.label: FY27 growth target ~20%
triggers.quote: we believe the business is positioned to deliver around 20% growth in the upcoming financial year

triggers.label: ~900 beds in execution, ~2.5 yrs
triggers.quote: nearly 900- plus beds in the execution phase, which are all likely to kind of complete in about 2.5 years' time

triggers.label: FY26 growth 12%; ~18–20% ex-seasonality
triggers.quote: Had seasonal demand been at normal levels, growth could have been closer to 18%–20%.

guidance.quote: we believe the business is positioned to deliver around 20% growth in the upcoming financial year
we would expect occupancy to be in the range of 56%–57%
mature hospitals should be able to operate at around 60% occupancy
we expect ARPP to grow by around 5%–6% annually

guidance.value: ~25% YoY for at least three years
guidance.quote: we expect the fertility business to continue growing at approximately 25% year-on-year for at least the next three years
Maintenance capex is approximately INR 45 crores per year across our network of around 25 units

guidance.value: INR 400–500 crore over next two years
guidance.quote: we expect to invest approximately INR 400– 500 crores in the Gurugram projects over the next two years
we expect to commence operations in H2 FY28
expected to commence operations in Q1 FY29

red_flags.label: Mature occupancy declining; FY26 growth 12% vs 20% target
red_flags.quote: Had seasonal demand been at normal levels, growth could have been closer to 18%–20%.

red_flags.label: Corrected cash figure on call
red_flags.quote: hold close to INR ~700 (it is ~600 Cr, regret the error) crores in cash

evasions.quote: as a matter of policy, we do not disclose pharmacy revenue separately
it is difficult to accurately quantify market share
